candidates.name: Boundary agreements and determined boundaries (PG40s4) collection
verified_facts: Official PG40 supplement 4 collection; last updated 1 June 2026.
Routes to current boundary-agreement/determined-boundary guidance and a determined-boundary plan-requirements PDF.
semantic_limits: Collection/update history is authority-routing evidence; it does not prove a parcel already has a determined boundary.

candidates.name: Determined boundary plan requirements PDF
verified_facts: Official one-page example shows an exact boundary identified through labelled points, measured ties, orientation and certification.
The example is associated with PG40 supplement 4 determined-boundary plan requirements.
semantic_limits: An example plan is procedural evidence and cannot establish the exact line for the three measured parcels.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans: title plan (PG40s5) collection
verified_facts: Official title-plan collection was last updated 13 July 2026.
It states that the title plan is one of three registered-title elements and must be read with the register and filed documents.
semantic_limits: Collection currentness and title-plan routing do not make general boundaries exact sampling geometry.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans: boundaries (PG40s3) collection
verified_facts: Official boundaries collection was last updated 1 June 2026.
It routes to current guidance on legal, physical, general and determined boundaries.
semantic_limits: Guide routing/currentness is not parcel-specific legal-boundary evidence.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 metadata
verified_facts: OS Terrain 5 supplies GEMINI XML metadata on a per-tile basis.
Metadata includes tile reference, horizontal/vertical CRS, version number, reason for change and lineage statement.
Tile lineage can state created from new imagery, partly revised from new imagery, or imagery examined with no change.
semantic_limits: Tile metadata is lineage/context; publication/version metadata is not a parcel acquisition timestamp or vertical-accuracy measurement.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 downloads
verified_facts: OS publishes separate XML schema resources for contour products, gridded products and viewing-style metadata.
semantic_limits: Schema availability validates structure/encoding only and does not establish height accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 technical specification
verified_facts: Terrain 5 grid and contour products are created from the same source data and supplied as 5 km tiles.
The grid is a regular 5 m-post-spacing height product; contours are 5 m interval vector lines with spot heights.
semantic_limits: Common source lineage does not make contour/spot-height representations interchangeable with the primary 1 m EA DTM raster.

candidates.name: GeoPackage Extension for Tiled Gridded Coverage Data 1.1
verified_facts: Approved OGC standard for tiled regular gridded coverages such as elevation.
Defines ancillary coverage/tile tables, scale/offset/null semantics and TIFF/PNG encodings.
For elevation, the spatial reference system is used to define vertical datum, reference geoid and units.
semantic_limits: GeoPackage conformance/encoding does not validate EA source values or parcel-specific lineage.

candidates.name: GeoPackage WKT for Coordinate Reference Systems Extension 1.1
verified_facts: Approved OGC extension encodes CRS definitions using WKT2 in GeoPackage.
Version 1.1 adds coordinate epoch support for dynamic coordinate reference systems.
semantic_limits: CRS/epoch encoding removes ambiguity but does not improve terrain measurement accuracy or identify a survey.

candidates.name: OGC API - Processes - Part 1: Core
verified_facts: Approved OGC API standard wraps computational tasks as executable server processes.
Processes can combine raster, vector, coverage or point-cloud inputs and produce derived outputs.
semantic_limits: Process results are derived outputs and are not silently treated as native EA DTM observations.

candidates.name: GeoPackage Encoding Standard
verified_facts: OGC GeoPackage is an interoperable container with registered extension mechanisms.
Current guidance strongly recommends CRS WKT extension because of limitations in older CRS encoding.
semantic_limits: Container compliance and extension declarations do not certify elevation authority, RMSE or survey date.

candidates.name: OGC API - Tiles - Part 1: Core
verified_facts: Coverage tiles can contain measured quantities in gridded form.
A coverage tile can be generated using a subset plus resampling operation.
semantic_limits: A coverage tile may be derived/resampled and cannot be assumed to be a native-resolution source cell.

candidates.name: OGC CDB Version 2 - Part 1: Core Standard
verified_facts: The current CDB standard treats elevation models as gridded coverages.
Coverages may use multiple encodings and are independent from service definitions.
semantic_limits: Encoding/service independence is architecture evidence only; it does not validate an EA terrain value.

candidates.name: Abstract Specification Topic 23 - GeoPackage Conceptual and Logical Model
verified_facts: Defines conceptual/logical classes for coverage tiles and tiled gridded coverages in GeoPackage.
Separates coverage content, tile ancillary data and container structure.
semantic_limits: Conceptual-model conformance does not establish numeric terrain truth.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 metadata
verified_facts: OS Terrain metadata is supplied as XML with a viewing stylesheet and tile/product identification context.
semantic_limits: Terrain 50 metadata remains secondary coarse-product lineage and cannot validate 1 m parcel extrema.
